from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

smi = ("[W+](N=O)(P(C)(C)C)"
       "(C%13=C[C@@H](N(C)C(=O)C%12)[C@H]%12C[C@H](C#N)%13)"
       "(N%20N%23=CC=C%20)(N%21N%24=CC=C%21)(N%22N%25=CC=C%22)"
       "[BH-]<-%23<-%24<-%25")
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
rw = Chem.RWMol(mol)
# find and remove W-B bond
W = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="W"][0]
B = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="B"][0]
rw.RemoveBond(W, B)
m = rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
print("sanitized; charge:", Chem.GetFormalCharge(m))
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# stereo centers
print(Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
best = None
for seed in range(100):
    m2 = Chem.AddHs(m)
    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed = seed
    if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m2, ps)==0:
        conf = m2.GetConformer(); pos = conf.GetPositions()
        Wi = [a.GetIdx() for a in m2.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="W"][0]
        ds = {n.GetSymbol()+str(n.GetIdx()): np.linalg.norm(pos[Wi]-pos[n.GetIdx()]) for n in m2.GetAtomWithIdx(Wi).GetNeighbors()}
        Bi = [a.GetIdx() for a in m2.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="B"][0]
        dB = np.linalg.norm(pos[Wi]-pos[Bi])
        okd = all(1.8 < v < 2.7 for v in ds.values()) and dB > 3.0
        print(seed, {k: round(v,2) for k,v in ds.items()}, "W-B", round(dB,2), "OK" if okd else "")
